تحتفلوا (form VIII)
# تَحْتَفِلُوا (taḥtafilū) /taħ.ta.fi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
# تُحْتَفَلُوا (tuḥtafalū) /tuħ.ta.fa.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
